title: Chapter 1197
text:
The battle of Dragon Hill seemed to have become a signal. In the next two days, fire beacons were lit all over Planet Milton. The players of the various guild alliances fought endlessly, and the battlefields changed from one place to another. There were hundreds of thousands of battlefields all over the strongholds at every moment. Planet Milton seemed to have been bombarded for two days in a row, and the surface was devastated by tens of millions of players.

There were no other topics on the forums. There were basically only two kinds of posts. One was the enthusiastic greetings from the opposing players to each other's ancestors, and the other was the battle reports from the Galaxy Times and the various war reporters.

Because there were too many battlefields, Han Xiao could not read all of them. He only paid attention to the Golden Alliance's results on the first day. After seeing that the Golden Alliance had won the battle of Dragon Hill and made a good start, he did not follow closely. Basically, he only looked at the battle reports from Pork Bun and the Galaxy Times every few hours to understand the overall changes in the World Server War.

Overall, the Golden Alliance currently had the biggest advantage. The Galactic Business Alliance and the other guild alliances had suffered heavy losses on the first day of the battle, so they had obviously become much more cautious. They did not dare to act recklessly anymore and started to use dirty tactics to attack the various strongholds of the Golden Alliance.

The Golden Alliance and the three Universal Civilizations' battlefront led by the September Meeting did not organize any large-scale battles in the past two days. At most, there were small skirmishes. The ones who had the most fun in the past two days were the neutral casual players.

The neutral casual players had the most players. Many casual guilds formed temporary small alliances. Not only did they kill each other crazily, but there were also some fierce players who formed teams to attack the strongholds of the three major factions, such as the Black Star Corps. Most of them were repelled, but a small number of them succeeded in taking down some strongholds from the three mainstream factions.

In similar activities, cleaning up the casual players was the first thing to do. The big fish would eat the small fish before killing each other to prevent others from sneaking up on them. However, the situation here was special. The intensity of the war was extremely high, and the resurrection count, which players usually did not care about, had become the most important strategic resource.

The three main factions had the ability to eliminate any unaffiliated forces, but it was impossible for them to come out unscathed. The players were not afraid of death and would not give up resisting, so they would definitely cause them some losses. In their eyes, it was a complete waste to use their precious resurrection times on unaffiliated forces. They would not use battle to sustain battle, and their forces would only become more and more damaged. They would be at an innate disadvantage in battle.

Furthermore, if they were to wipe out the scattered players on a large scale, there was an 80% chance that the scattered players would band together to resist. At that time, they might end up shooting themselves in the foot and be beaten up by the scattered players instead.

Although there was no time limit in the war's rules, everyone had a tacit understanding that a victor had to be decided within six days. Otherwise, the respawn count would be refreshed, and the Guild Alliance would suffer a huge loss.

After all, even if players could revive, their resources would decrease as the battle progressed. If another round of battles occurred, the Guild Alliance's treasury would suffer a massive loss. Moreover, ordinary players would not be willing to accept the death penalty too many times.

In the exclusive workshop of the Black Star Palace, Han Xiao put away a freshly made King mechanical suit, opened the forum, and roughly browsed through today's battle report.

[Golden Alliance's Eight-Hour Battle Report: Victory Rate Continues to Rise – by Pork Bun Beating Dog: "The Golden Alliance has conducted a total of 41 battles in the past eight hours, including 4 million level battles, 11 500,000 level local battles, 22 100,000 level local battles, 4 small-scale team battles, and no ten million level battles. Among them, they won 29 battles and lost 12 battles. Victory rate%, an increase of 3.16% compared to yesterday. The overall average death rate has increased from 2.375 to 2.814, continuing to lead the guild's average survival ranking. The gap between them and the second place continues to widen. Currently, the gap is 0.703! "]

[Victory at the Flying Stone Cliff – by Galaxy Times (Huaxia Region): "Today, the Galactic Business Alliance and the Northern Battlefront's stronghold in the Haywood Valley was raided by the September Council and Denland. Due to the interference of the teleportation portal, the Galactic Business Alliance and the Northern Battlefront deployed troops nearby to reinforce the Haywood Valley stronghold. However, they were ambushed by the Golden Alliance when they passed by the Flying Stone Cliff and suffered heavy losses. It is reported that the Golden Alliance secretly sent a troop to log off here yesterday and used the strategy of going online to catch the enemy off guard and achieve a great victory with a loss ratio of less than 0.6: 1! "]

[A Daily Drama – By Yan Huang Alliance War Reporters: "Today, another tragedy has occurred that was caused by external factors. A boss of the Gorehowl Headshot Cult bribed a high-level mage player in the Sithe Empire's main stronghold. This mole secretly tampered with the magic circuit of the second material teleportation portal in the main base when his teammates were not paying attention and left a teleportation beacon. When the two guild alliances were fighting fiercely, the Gorehowl Headshot Cult used this beacon to send a fully-armed troop into the enemy's stronghold, causing the Sithe Empire to be wiped out on the spot! After that, this mole and the boss were blacklisted by all the major guilds and have been eliminated. Let us reiterate this once more — outside the game, your mother will definitely raise the price of her groceries tonight! "]

There were countless similar battle reports. Han Xiao glanced through them happily and looked at which guild alliances had been eliminated today. He scrolled through the posts for about half an hour before exiting the forum.

Beep beep beep!

At this time, his communicator rang. It was the dynasty's exploration army marshal, Brother Tarrokov, whom he had not contacted for a long time.

"Oh, it's Old Tarrokov. What's the matter?" Han Xiao accepted the call and asked with a smile.

"Have you been paying attention to the war between the Immortals?" Tarrokov's tone was serious.

"Heh, I have a bunch of Immortals under my command. How can I not be paying attention to it? Do you still need to test me like this? Did the dynasty's upper echelons send you here? "

Han Xiaoxin roughly guessed the other party's intentions.

"Hmm …" Tarrokov did not deny it and slowly said, "What I want to ask is, how much do you know about the Immortals?"

Han Xiao rolled his eyes and asked, "Be more specific."

"Alright … the intelligence department and the dynasty's science department have never stopped observing the Immortals. The earliest batch of Immortals appeared in Blue Star and were basically recruited by you. You seem to have a deep understanding of them. We want to know, why do the Immortals disappear from time to time? Why do they become stronger after disappearing on a large scale? Is there a limit to this improvement? Can they really be completely controlled? "

A series of questions were thrown at him, but Han Xiao did not immediately reply. His eyes flickered as he felt the change in the attitude of the Red Empire.

The three Universal Civilizations had always been researching the Immortals, and now, they finally came to ask him, the 'expert' on the surface. It was because of the World Server War that they paid more attention to the Immortals!

The nickname 'Cancer of the Universe' had been used for more than half of the version. The players had always been scattered and active in different events. Even in the Black Star Corps Martial Arts Tournament, it was only a group battle. However, this time, the various organizations had truly witnessed a large-scale war that only the Immortals participated in.

The weapons and fleets were not exaggerated, and the scene was not as spectacular as a galactic war. Only the intensity of the battle between the Supers was shocking. The Immortals of different factions had fought before, but this time, it was especially terrifying.

The advanced civilizations could still remain calm and only felt surprised. However, the smaller organizations could be said to be frightened!

So, this is the battle between the Cancer of the Universe. We still underestimated the ferocity of these people!

Thinking of the characteristics of the Immortals in the past, the dynasty did not have the leisure to continue their research and found Han Xiao, wanting to ask for more detailed information.

"I don't know that much. You guys probably already know what I know …"

Of course, Han Xiao would not reveal anything. He casually said some information that could be observed by the various organizations. There was nothing special about it.

"You really only know this much?" Tarrokov did not give up.

"What else? I just concluded some patterns earlier. I'm not an Immortal, so how can I know everything? "Han Xiao laughed.

"That's true …"

Tarrokov nodded.

In truth, the Red Empire had also suspected whether or not Black Star was an Immortal a few decades ago.

However, no one had been able to kill him, so they could not find out the truth.

In the end, because Black Star would not disappear intermittently like the Immortals, the dynasty dispelled this suspicion.

After sending Tarrokov away, Han Xiao stopped smiling, and his expression became serious.

He turned off the interface, looked at the EXP bar, and estimated.

With my current efficiency of harvesting EXP, I'll have enough EXP to complete my level 340 Promotion before the start of the Pro League. Hmm, I can use the Evolution Cube again.

Han Xiao frowned.

As the strength of the players increased, the situation in the universe would become more turbulent. He could only deal with all the changes by reaching a higher level as soon as possible. At that time, no matter how the advanced civilizations reacted, he would be able to deal with them.

…

The players of the Limitless Financial Group were also part of the World Server War and belonged to one of the large organizations in the neutral faction.

Sorokin was also paying attention to this battle, but he was not just observing. He had other plans in his mind.

"This seems to be a good opportunity to attract the Immortals …"

Sorokin's eyes sparkled.

He had always been passionate about recruiting Immortals. Although he did not know the truth about the players, Han Xiao's method had given him some inspiration.

Sorokin had carefully studied the history of the Black Star Corps, especially the methods the Black Star Corps used to attract the Immortals. He had found many patterns in the past.

At this point, Sorokin felt that he had already learned all of Black Star's methods.

"This time, with so many Immortals fighting among themselves, it's a good opportunity for the Limitless Financial Group to become famous among the Immortals. If the Immortals of the Limitless Financial Group win in the end, they should be able to attract some Immortals to join the financial group …"

Under normal circumstances, the Immortals of the Limitless Financial Group would not have any advantage. If he wanted them to win, he would have to interfere. After all, he was not like the other Beyond Grade As who were affected by reputation. Even if news of a Beyond Grade A shamelessly interfering in a fight between Grade B Supers spread, it would not affect his reputation.

As a Beyond Grade A, even if he did not reveal his true strength, he would be able to determine the outcome of a battle of this level. Furthermore, his ability was extremely well-hidden, and he believed that these Grade B Immortals would not be able to discover anything.

"Looks like it's worth a try. Let's do it …" Sorokin secretly made up his mind.

His guess was actually not far from the truth, but he could not see the forums, so he lacked the most crucial information … He did not know the reason for the players fighting at all, nor did he know that NPCs were not allowed to interfere in the rules!

The players of the Limitless Financial Group did not dare break the rules and invested a lot of resources to fight the national war, diligently maintaining their current good results …

However, what they did not expect was that their own faction leader was preparing to take them all away.
